label: 1,000-person RSVP'd event at BSC (7–10 PM)
description: The headline scenario: a sold-out student event at the Busch Student Center. ~72% of RSVPs show up, arriving across the 30 minutes before doors and leaving in a wave after the last act. Watch the B/A/H stops on Busch fill, the buses turn red, and the left-behind counter climb.
